moments.action: A driver in a black tank top throws a black coupe down the spiral ramps of an empty parking garage, smoke off the rear tyres; the cutting tightens to his eyes and the pedal, then pulls out to an aerial of the car swinging round the tower.
The coupe bursts out of the garage onto a neon-lit street and swings into a long smoking drift; the crowd packed behind the barriers goes up, arms and phones in the air.

Reaction cuts along the crowd line: a young man in a red-and-white beanie and the girl beside him stay flat-faced while everyone around them cheers; the car swings round to face them, headlights full on, and a bleached-hair man grins.
The driver climbs out and walks straight at the bleached-hair man in the leather jacket, then breaks into a grin as a woman reaches him; by the last shot he has turned away into the applauding crowd.

A second driver, a young man in a grey sleeveless shirt and green harness, starts his run grinning and hammers an orange-and-blue race car down the same ramps; by the fourth shot its front end is torn open and he is fighting the wheel.

Down in the street the crowd mills and then turns to face the garage exit; inside it the first driver and the dark-haired woman press their foreheads together, and the beanie man and the girl watch, saying nothing.

The battered orange car slides out and stops smoking in front of the crowd. The bleached-hair man leans in to talk to a spiky-haired man, a long-haired man in a grey jacket pushes forward, and the barrier line breaks and swarms the car.

The couple lean together one last time and she looks down; the orange car's driver sits tense in his seat as the long-haired man in the grey jacket stoops to his window to speak, then the crowd closes over the frame into blurred bodies.

From a dark wooden doorway the scene lands in a dim house at night: a grey-haired man in a NAVY hoodie sits alone with a beer. The young driver edges round the sliding door, caught coming in, and the older man begins talking.

The young man comes to the lit table and stands over it rather than sitting; the older man keeps pressing from his chair, bottles in front of him, and the last shot holds tight on the young man as his face goes blank.
